answer: A grove of trusted peers co-signs attestations, and any duplicate hardware fingerprint burns the bond. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a bond tied to a verified hardware root, and reputation accrues in a spiral where new identities start at zero. Attackers must buy distinct hardware and post real collateral per fake identity, making mass forgery costlier than honest participation. Each bond carries a unique pigment mark in the registry, so clones are detected cheaply. From sa0019's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
